nodes.label: CyberAlchemy Define
nodes.plain_language: Preserve a bounded goal and its intent while turning the meaning needed to continue into checked concepts and visible open questions.
nodes.claim: CyberAlchemy Define gives every required concept one explicit current disposition while preserving the goal, intent, evidence, scope, owner, relations, questions, and authority limits for any named consumer.
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not a product, system, experience, interface, or brand solution; not definition promotion, implementation, execution, or the whole CyberAlchemy product.

nodes.label: Shared Meaning For Continued Work
nodes.plain_language: People and tools continue from the same checked concepts instead of silently different meanings.
nodes.claim: Define aims to reduce semantic conflict and lost evidence before any consumer hardens decisions around ambiguous terms.
nodes.forbidden_collapse: A desired outcome is not measured reduction in rework, conflict, or time.

nodes.label: Definition Pack
nodes.plain_language: One reviewable bundle that keeps the goal, intent, concept decisions, evidence, owners, relations, open questions, and consulted bounded language together.
nodes.claim: The product output keeps the bounded goal traceable to its intent while preserving complete required-concept coverage, unresolved meaning, the Language Context View identity, digest, source epoch, and applied binding references for the next consumer.

source_refs.selector: The Definition Pack preserves the identity and digest

nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not a canonical registry, chosen solution, executable plan, or proof of complete intent.

nodes.label: Language Context View
nodes.plain_language: A bounded, read-only view of the language Define may use for one context, intended use, and exact source epoch.
nodes.claim: The view carries its identity and digest together with usable concept, meaning, realization, relationship, owner, evidence, conflict, and blocked-use bindings so Define can reuse meaning without guessing.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 Language Project owner plus CyberAlchemy v2 product owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not a canonical registry, accepted Definition Pack, authority envelope, selected open realization, or proof that Define interpreted the language correctly.

nodes.label: Define Handled Definition Registry
nodes.plain_language: A durable candidate collection of what Define did with each important concept in one exact context: reuse it, narrow it, propose it, or keep it open.
nodes.claim: Define maintains context-bound semantic handling records with one current disposition, exact sources, a decision owner, named consumers, and a challenge or refresh route while keeping registry custody separate from authority over meaning.
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not the canonical definition store, definition truth, owner appointment, contextual acceptance, promotion, runtime persistence, or authority to use a record downstream.

nodes.label: Resolve Or Expose Every Required Concept
nodes.plain_language: Every important concept receives a supported decision or stays visible as an open question.
nodes.claim: Define must not silently omit a required concept or hide missing evidence behind a complete-looking pack.
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Total coverage of a bounded concept set is not proof that open-ended human intent is complete.

nodes.label: Human Choice Remains Visible
nodes.plain_language: The wizard may prepare and recommend, but it shows important choices instead of making them silently.
nodes.claim: Define preserves answers, non-answers, alternatives, and consequential choices for the responsible person.
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not a human approval gate for every harmless read, draft, or reversible local step.

nodes.label: Question And Evidence Continuity
nodes.plain_language: The same questions, answers, evidence, and gaps survive across time, CLI, and chat.
nodes.claim: A Define interaction must be resumable without forcing the person to reconstruct prior meaning and decisions.
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not universal memory, hidden user profiling, or proof that no context is lost.

nodes.label: Progressive Context Sufficiency
nodes.plain_language: Use explicit intent context and references first, then visible current-window and saved-session context, and ask for more only when the bounded evidence remains insufficient or indeterminate.
nodes.claim: Define minimizes repeated explanation while keeping inferred context provenance-marked, correctable, non-authoritative, and unable to hide an unresolved context gap.
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not permission to infer private human state, treat inference as a user answer, or claim complete intent or implemented sufficiency evaluation.

nodes.label: Apply Bounded Language Or Expose The Gap
nodes.plain_language: Define applies exact usable language bindings and keeps missing, stale, conflicting, ambiguous, or owner-unresolved language visible.
nodes.claim: Every applied language meaning remains traceable to the consulted Language Context View and source digest; Define must not invent equivalence, silently choose an open realization, or drop owner and blocked-use information.

source_refs.selector: It must not silently invent equivalence

nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus Language Project owner plus CyberAlchemy v2 Define product owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not permission to infer missing meaning, promote a definition, choose an unresolved DomainSpec type, or claim correct agent interpretation.

nodes.label: Bounded And Visible Authority
nodes.plain_language: The product shows who may make each consequential result count, for which scope and effect.
nodes.claim: Define evidence, recommendations, generated artifacts, and validation results do not create authority by themselves.
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not ownership, participation, confidence, evidence, access, or a global permission.

nodes.label: Governance Serves Define
nodes.plain_language: Routine evidence and ownership checks stay in the system; human-interrupting gates appear only at real consequence boundaries.
nodes.claim: Define uses the least visible ceremony that preserves meaning, evidence, ownership, reversibility, and authority boundaries.
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Not no governance, no gates, automatic safety, or permission to cross a consequence boundary.

nodes.label: Preserve DomainSpec Construction Readiness
nodes.plain_language: Define preserves the exact definition and business-ontology handoff needed for later DomainSpec v2 system construction, and leaves every unresolved predecessor visible.
nodes.claim: A Define result may be construction-ready only when it names the exact canonical definitions, product-ontology records, capability business-ontology records, digests, owner routes, validation outcomes, residue, and challenge routes that the DomainSpec v2 project must consume.
nodes.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus CyberAlchemy v2 Define product owner
nodes.forbidden_collapse: Define does not own DomainSpec compilation, system-ontology admission, implementation binding, conformance, Constitution adoption, or runtime enforcement.
